Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Roorkee Research Associate Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Research Associate post at IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Research Associate post at IIT Roorkee is scheduled for 11 September 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance for registration formalities.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The required educational qualification for the Research Associate position is an M.B.A in Disaster Management. Ensure you meet this criterion before attending the interview.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for the Research Associate role?
faq.answer: The salary offered for the Research Associate role ranges from Rs. 30,000 to Rs. 75,000 per month, plus HRA. This is a contractual position.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Research Associate post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Research Associate post at the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee for the Research Associate recruitment?
faq.answer: There is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST, Women) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q6. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies, including ID proof, educational certificates, and any other relevant documents as specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Associate position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Associate position involves an Interview and Document Verification.

faq.question: Q8. Where is the walk-in interview for IIT Roorkee Research Associate recruitment being held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at the IIT Roorkee office. The specific address and reporting time will be available in the official notification.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual position for a Research Associate at IIT Roorkee. The job type is explicitly mentioned as contractual.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification for this recruitment?
